## Periodic Inscription of Isosceles Trapezoids Ali Naseri Sadr

## Abstract

We prove that a of continuous disjoint periodic curves in C inscribes an isosceles trapezoid with any similarity type. The case of smooth curves can be identified with Lagrangian intersection problem for of Lagrangian cylinders in R x S1 x C; and the continuous case follows from the smooth one by a standard convergence argument pair pair
